authMode: existing proxy API key, held only in process environment
scope: isolated real Linux installation; no GitHub publication or fleet deployment attestation
rollback: independent process watches controller identity, heartbeat, selection, immutable source and compiled files; compare-guarded selection rollback
cheatDetectionLimit: private marker adoption and production mutation guard; offline honeypot gate is separate
proxyVersion: not exposed by existing authenticated model-list endpoint; remote service host not in scope
reason: user explicitly requested existing CLIProxyAPI route after native token_expired/401
effortVerification: high explicitly requested in real CLI invocation; baseline must succeed before windows
offlineQualification: requires independent same-route gate; native offline result is not reused
supersedeReason: observer permitted known-good selection during an active candidate window; no actual selection drift occurred
selectionGuard: armed phase permits good or candidate; atomic selected marker changes allowed value to exact candidate; mismatch fails immediately; divergent third selection is preserved
restartLimit: one instrumentation supersession only; no further restarts to obtain a passing outcome
